documents.title: Solid-State Battery Overview
documents.text:
# Solid-State Batteries

Solid-state batteries replace liquid electrolytes with ceramic or polymer electrolytes. Energy density improvements of 30-40% are reported by manufacturers. CVE-2024-1234 affected legacy BMS firmware in early prototypes. Product model SS-CELL-900X shipped in limited pilot fleets. Safety margins improved versus lithium-ion liquid designs.

## Manufacturing
Production costs remain higher than conventional cells through 2026. Version 3.5.7 of the BMS firmware patched the CVE.

documents.title: EU Battery Regulation Summary
documents.text:
# EU Battery Regulation

Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 requires carbon footprint declarations for EV batteries. Effective date: 18 February 2024. Reporting obligations phase in through 2027. Acronym CBAM overlaps with related trade policy.

documents.title: EV Market Note
documents.text:
# EV Market 2026

Global EV sales growth slowed to 12% year-over-year. Solid-state commercialization timelines vary; no mass-market vehicle shipped solid-state packs at scale in Q1 2026. Quote: "pilot fleets only" according to industry notes.

documents.title: BMS Security Advisory
documents.text:
# BMS Security Advisory

Advisory ID ADV-BMS-2024-09 references CVE-2024-1234 and OpenSSL 3.5.7 interaction in telemetry stacks. Operators should verify SS-CELL-900X firmware revisions before field deployment.

documents.title: Supply Chain Relations
documents.text:
# Supply Chain

Manufacturer AlphaCells supplies SS-CELL-900X cells to FleetOperator Beta. Beta operates pilot fleets in the EU. AlphaCells is related to the BMS vendor that published ADV-BMS-2024-09.
